name: CHARM
fullName: Intravenous Glibenclamide for Cerebral Oedema after Large Hemispheric Stroke
population: n=535, 18-85 (primary analysis restricted to 18-70), NIHSS large hemispheric infarction, study drug started within 10 h of onset
finding: Trial STOPPED EARLY for slow COVID-era enrolment before the planned sample was reached
teachingPoint: IV glibenclamide for large hemispheric infarction remains unproven — CHARM was halted early and underpowered.

name: DECIMAL
fullName: Early Decompressive Craniectomy in Malignant Middle Cerebral Artery Infarction
population: n=38, 18-55, NIHSS malignant MCA infarction, early (protocol ≤24 h of randomization eligibility)
finding: mRS ≤3: 25% vs 5.6% at 6 mo (P=0.18); 50% vs 22.2% at 1 y (P=0.10) — underpowered; mortality reduced by 52.8 pp (P<0.0001)
teachingPoint: One of the three European trials whose pooled analysis made early hemicraniectomy standard for malignant MCA infarction in younger patients.

name: DESTINY
fullName: Decompressive Surgery for the Treatment of Malignant Infarction of the Middle Cerebral Artery
population: n=32, adults (≤60 by design), NIHSS malignant MCA infarction, early hemicraniectomy
finding: 30-day survival 88% vs 47% (P=0.02); mRS 0-3 at 6-12 mo: 47% vs 27% (P=0.23) — primary endpoint not significant alone
teachingPoint: Demonstrated the survival benefit of hemicraniectomy in malignant MCA infarction; functional benefit established in the pooled analysis.

name: HAMLET
fullName: Hemicraniectomy After Middle Cerebral Artery Infarction with Life-threatening Edema Trial
population: n=64, adults, NIHSS space-occupying hemispheric infarction, randomized within 4 days of onset
finding: No effect on primary outcome (ARR 0%, 95% CI −21 to 21); case fatality reduced (ARR 38%, 95% CI 15-60)
teachingPoint: Operate within 48 h: delayed decompression saves lives but has no demonstrated functional benefit.

name: DESTINY II
fullName: Hemicraniectomy in Older Patients with Extensive Middle-Cerebral-Artery Stroke
population: n=112, ≥61 (median 70, range 61-82), NIHSS malignant MCA infarction, randomized within 48 h of onset
teachingPoint: Hemicraniectomy improves survival without severe disability in patients >60, at the cost of survival largely into mRS 4-5.
